findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: assinafy_find_documents · Private data: assinafy_check_fields, assinafy_delete_document, assinafy_download_document, assinafy_find_documents, assinafy_find_signers, assinafy_follow_up_assignment, assinafy_prepare_document, assinafy_request_signatures, assinafy_save_signer, assinafy_verify_document · Public sink: assinafy_find_documents, assinafy_prepare_document, assinafy_request_signatures · Destructive: assinafy_delete_document.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: assinafy_find_documents · Private data: assinafy_check_fields, assinafy_delete_document, assinafy_download_document, assinafy_find_documents, assinafy_find_signers, assinafy_follow_up_assignment, assinafy_prepare_document, assinafy_request_signatures, assinafy_save_signer, assinafy_verify_document · Public sink: assinafy_find_documents, assinafy_prepare_document, assinafy_request_signatures · Destructive: assinafy_delete_document

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
